text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's morning. Heading towards the office,
I
happen to see Manhattan Cafe in the
middle of
training.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I gasp at what looks like waterfalls of
sweat. Just
how long as she been here
running?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now that I think of it, last night too...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... I... can keep running...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I have to run... even faster... so I can...
catch up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe she's right back to
training this
early despite how late she
was at it last night.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Not really. I do this... all the time.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It's quiet at night... And I can... see the
other side
more clearly...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
If I focus... I can see my Friend... running
in front.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Bright-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me! Cafe, can I have a
moment?
choice_data_list: 昨夜は君しかいなかったような……
昨夜は貴方しかいなかったような……
choice_data_list_en: I could've sworn it was just you last night...
I could have sworn it was only you last night...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: No, we haven't... met before.

text_block_list.name: Bright-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah! Nice to meet you! To tell you
the truth,
I...

text_block_list.name: Bright-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I think you're amazing the way you train
diligently
all by yourself!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Amazing? All I'm doing is... running.

text_block_list.name: Bright-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah, but I still think that's amazing.
So, um... if
it's fine by you, could we
train together?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: You want to train... with me?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Sure. I don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Bright-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Th-thank you! I'll do my best to keep up!

text_block_list.name: Bright-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I thought I'd be able to keep up... but
before I
knew it, I was left so far
behind...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I knew... when to up my pace... from your

breathing. I must've thrown you off your
rhythm...
just a little.

text_block_list.name: Bright-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah, haha... You read me like a book.
You're right,
I probably messed up my
pacing out of panic.

text_block_list.name: Bright-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
You're truly amazing. Once you took the
lead, it
seemed like you'd never let me
have it back.

text_block_list.name: Bright-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
You seemed zeroed in on the path
ahead.
Weren't you concerned about
how close I
might've been?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
After... I passed you... my Friend was still
ahead...

text_block_list.name: Bright-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I see... I gotta admit, that's a little
frustrating.

text_block_list.name: Bright-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Oh, never mind! Thank you for training
with me
today! Let's run again some
other time! See you!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: What a... strange girl...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
What is there to be gained... from
running... with
me?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I'm just... trying to catch up... to my
Friend.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe gazes yearningly
towards the
clearly vacant track, then
breaks into a run.
